website.title: Show this content on your website
website.subtitle: Your website reads announcements, health tips, FAQs, doctors, contact and timings from here, so it updates by itself when you change them.
website.endpointHint: GET, with the header Authorization: Bearer <your website key>. Returns JSON.
website.step1: Create a website key (button above). It gets only the permission “Portal content: view”.
website.step2: If the website's own pages will call the API, add the website address (https://www.yourhospital.com) to the key's allowed websites. Calls from your website's server need no website address.
website.step3: Give the key and the code below to your web developer. You can revoke the key at any time in Administration › API keys.
website.includes: Included: hospital name and logo, about, contact, timings, the doctors listed for the portal, announcements within their dates, and tips and FAQs switched “Also on the hospital website”. Never anything about a patient. Changes appear within a minute.
website.security: Safest: call the API from your website's server, so the key stays secret. In the browser the key is visible to anyone who views the page source; it then works only from the allowed websites, and can only read this public content.
website.codeSubtitle: Two ways: from the website's server (recommended), or from the page in the browser.
website.browserCode: From the page in the browser (JavaScript)
